description: prov_arm create/frontdoor deploys only through frontdoor.bicepparam.

patches.find:
create/frontdoor)
        SAF_FRONTDOOR_JSON="$(cat "$inputs")" az deployment group create --resource-group "$where" --name "$name" \
          --parameters "$prov_frontdoor_param"
patches.replace:
create/frontdoor)
        SAF_FRONTDOOR_JSON="$(cat "$inputs")" az deployment group create --resource-group "$where" --name "$name" \
          --parameters "$prov_release_param"
